label: Livelihood protection
definition: The row says how far the NbS reduces the hazard's impact on rural livelihoods (production, income). Feeds Module 2 (risk to livelihoods), a need layer for hotspots.
source_ref: schema/spec.md T3.risk_role; AGENTS.md lock 'Two risk lenses are distinct'

label: Threat to the works
definition: The row says how badly the hazard damages the NbS itself (the investment). Feeds Module 2b (project disaster-risk screen), applied as a filter, never summed with livelihood risk.
source_ref: schema/spec.md T3.risk_role; AGENTS.md lock 'Two risk lenses are distinct'

label: Livelihood protection and threat to the works
ttl_label: Protects farmers from <hazard>, and is threatened by it
definition: The row carries both lenses: a livelihood mitigation class (M2) and an asset sensitivity class (M2b) for the same hazard.

label: Very negative
definition: Reconciled rank −3: the evidence shows the NbS strongly increases the hazard's impact on livelihoods.

label: Negative
definition: Reconciled rank −1 or −2: the evidence shows the NbS increases the hazard's impact on livelihoods.

label: No effect
definition: Rank 0, emitted only when the evidence reports a null; never the result of positive and negative findings cancelling.

label: Low mitigation
definition: Reconciled rank +1 (slight): the modal-sign weighted median of the evidence is a slight reduction of the hazard's impact.

label: Moderate mitigation
definition: Reconciled rank +2 (moderate reduction of the hazard's impact).

label: High mitigation
definition: Reconciled rank +3 (strong reduction of the hazard's impact) without the confidence needed for very high.

label: Very high mitigation
definition: Reconciled rank +3 AND confidence high or very high: the top class is earned by evidence, not by one enthusiastic paper.

label: Conflicting evidence
definition: Material weight on both signs (the minority side carries at least 1/3 of the signed weight): the row states the conflict instead of a near-tie class. Not a zero and not 'no effect'.

label: Strongly negative
definition: Reconciled rank −3 in the benefit frame: the NbS strongly worsens the priority concern.

label: Moderately negative
definition: Reconciled rank −2 in the benefit frame.

label: Slightly negative
definition: Reconciled rank −1 in the benefit frame.

label: No clear effect
definition: Emitted only when the evidence reports a null; never the result of positive and negative findings cancelling.

label: Slightly positive
definition: Reconciled rank +1 in the benefit frame: the NbS slightly improves the priority concern (reduces a high-is-bad variable or raises a low-is-bad one).

label: Moderately positive
definition: Reconciled rank +2 in the benefit frame.

label: Strongly positive
definition: Reconciled rank +3 in the benefit frame.

label: Conflicting evidence
definition: The IPCC outcome for mixed evidence: material weight on both signs (minority at least 1/3 of the signed weight) states the conflict instead of a near-tie class. no_relationship stays reserved for genuine nulls.

label: Not sensitive
definition: Reconciled damage rank 0: the evidence reports the hazard does not damage the NbS asset. Sourced from WOCAT tolerance ratings and literature (asset_vulnerability units).

label: Low sensitivity
definition: Reconciled damage rank +1: the hazard damages the NbS asset slightly. Sourced from WOCAT tolerance ratings and literature (asset_vulnerability units).

label: Moderate sensitivity
definition: Reconciled damage rank +2. Sourced from WOCAT tolerance ratings and literature (asset_vulnerability units).

label: High sensitivity
definition: Reconciled damage rank +3 without the confidence needed for very high. Sourced from WOCAT tolerance ratings and literature (asset_vulnerability units).

label: Very high sensitivity
definition: Reconciled damage rank +3 and confidence high or very high (same gate as mitigation very_high). Sourced from WOCAT tolerance ratings and literature (asset_vulnerability units).

label: Very low confidence
definition: IPCC calibrated confidence, derived (never authored) from evidence × agreement: Limited evidence with low agreement. Says how sure the literature is, not whether it applies to this place (see transfer class).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Low confidence
definition: IPCC calibrated confidence, derived (never authored) from evidence × agreement: Limited evidence with medium agreement, or medium evidence with low agreement. Says how sure the literature is, not whether it applies to this place (see transfer class).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Medium confidence
definition: IPCC calibrated confidence, derived (never authored) from evidence × agreement: Limited evidence with high agreement, medium evidence with medium agreement, or robust evidence with low agreement. Says how sure the literature is, not whether it applies to this place (see transfer class).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: High confidence
definition: IPCC calibrated confidence, derived (never authored) from evidence × agreement: Medium evidence with high agreement, or robust evidence with medium agreement. Says how sure the literature is, not whether it applies to this place (see transfer class).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Very high confidence
definition: IPCC calibrated confidence, derived (never authored) from evidence × agreement: Robust evidence with high agreement. Says how sure the literature is, not whether it applies to this place (see transfer class).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Limited evidence
definition: IPCC evidence axis (type, amount, quality, consistency), as this project counts it: At most 2 independent sources after lineage dedupe, or every unit is second-hand, an expert assertion or a practitioner rating.
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Medium evidence
definition: IPCC evidence axis (type, amount, quality, consistency), as this project counts it: 3–4 independent sources with a mixed basis.
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Robust evidence
definition: IPCC evidence axis (type, amount, quality, consistency), as this project counts it: At least 5 independent sources with at least 2 measured (primary or table) units, or at least 1 high-tier meta-analysis.
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Low agreement
definition: IPCC agreement axis, from weighted sign agreement A: Less than 60% of the contributing weight is on the modal sign (A < 0.6).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Medium agreement
definition: IPCC agreement axis, from weighted sign agreement A: 60–80% of the contributing weight is on the modal sign (0.6 ≤ A < 0.8).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: High agreement
definition: IPCC agreement axis, from weighted sign agreement A: At least 80% of the contributing weight is on the modal sign (A ≥ 0.8).
source_ref: Mastrandrea et al. 2010, Guidance Note for Lead Authors of the IPCC AR5 on Consistent Treatment of Uncertainties; project matrix schema/lookups/ipcc_confidence_matrix.csv, methodology/T3_T6_generation_method.md §7.3–7.4

label: Data deficient
definition: The cell holds evidence but may not state a class: it publishes a class only with two independent sources or one measured finding. Below that floor the row is still published with its evidence and says what is missing; a blank is not 'does not work'.
source_ref: Pete 2026-10-16 (decision thin_rows_floor, option B); implemented per methodology/decisions/2026-10-16_class_eligibility_applied.md

label: In context
definition: More than half of the contributing (pre-transfer) weight comes from evidence at context distance 0 from the row's target (global rows: WB-investable LIC/LMIC). Transferability is reported separately from confidence, never folded into it.

label: Adjacent context
definition: More than half of the weight is at context distance ≤ 1, but not a majority at distance 0. Transferability is reported separately from confidence, never folded into it.

label: Out of context
definition: More than half of the weight is at context distance 2 (e.g. high-income temperate evidence for an LMIC target). Transferability is reported separately from confidence, never folded into it.

label: Mixed context
definition: None of the above majorities, including an exact 50/50 split. Transferability is reported separately from confidence, never folded into it.

label: No applicable evidence
definition: Runtime state: the row's transfer class recomputed against the AOI is out_of_context, so the consumer receives a gap (row greyed) instead of the class.

label: Existing forest
definition: The unit measures what EXISTING forest does or what its loss costs (forest-vs-cleared, existing-mangrove protection). Evidence for keeping forest standing, not for planting: kept in its home family row, out of the NbS roll-up and every other family.

label: Existing wetland
definition: The unit measures what EXISTING wetlands or floodplains do. Evidence for keeping/restoring them, not for creation: routed to the restoration family row, out of the roll-up; income people already draw from an existing wetland is the opportunity cost of restoring and does not vote in livelihood cells.
source_ref: comparator_policy.csv (2026-10-08, row ratified_by 'pete (pending)'); Pete 2026-10-16 existing-use ruling (existing_wetland_home_family_vote A)

label: Existing coastal marsh
ttl_label: Compared with keeping existing coastal marsh
definition: Coastal marsh measured where it already stands: same rule as existing wetland, but routed to the coastal family row rather than the rewetting one.

label: Intact reference wetland
definition: A restored wetland measured against an INTACT one: a recovery shortfall, not harm. Kept as a recovery note and never sets a class; the baseline is the pre-restoration state.

label: Intact reference forest
definition: A restored or managed stand measured against intact or ungrazed native forest: a recovery shortfall or conservation benchmark, not an effect of the practice. Never sets a class.
source_ref: Pete 2026-10-16 (reference-shortfall rule, carried to forest restoration, agroforestry, riparian, mangrove); schema/lookups/comparator_policy.csv

label: Unmanaged state
definition: The practice measured against the unmanaged state (e.g. grazed vs ungrazed forest) rather than the farming-system counterfactual a T3 cell asks about (e.g. silvopasture vs open pasture). Informs the account and prose, never sets a T3 class.
source_ref: Pete 2026-10-19 (decision hazard_cell_comparator, from the batcheler24_6 hold)

label: Isolated practice
definition: The effect is measured for the NbS practice on its own, so it can be credited in full.
source_ref: Pete 2026-10-12 (review theme 1, option A); ruleset v1.6.7

label: Bundled practice
definition: The NbS is one component of a bundled intervention. Never credited in full: weighted by the stated share of the sample using the NbS component (floor 0.25), or a flat 0.6 when unstated.
source_ref: Pete 2026-10-12 (review theme 1, option A); ruleset v1.6.7

label: Farm household
definition: The value accrues to the farm household; it may set a poverty class.

label: Community
definition: The value accrues to the local community; it may set a poverty class (community and household are the poverty beneficiaries).

label: Society
definition: Societal value (e.g. avoided damage, benefit-cost to society) is reported alongside, in its own line, but never sets a poverty class.

label: Establishment cost
definition: What the money buys is establishment capital. An annualised establishment cost (per ha per year over the restoration event) is still establishment, never recurrent.

label: Recurrent cost
ttl_label: Ongoing cost to keep it running
definition: What the money buys is ongoing operations or maintenance; the paper must name the ongoing operations. Routed by what the money buys, never by its denominator.

label: Measured
definition: The claim was measured by the source itself (claim_basis primary_measured, table or figure_read).
source_ref: schema/spec.md EV.claim_basis; review-card buckets in scripts/build-row-review-batch.py

label: Second-hand
definition: The source reports a finding from another study (claim_basis cited_secondary); the primary is not in hand.
source_ref: schema/spec.md EV.claim_basis; review-card buckets in scripts/build-row-review-batch.py

label: Practitioner rating
definition: A WOCAT / compiler rating: self-reported, weighted ×0.5 against syntheses (design = practitioner_rating).

label: Modelled
definition: The claim comes from a model (claim_basis modelled or design model); a modelled-only pool is capped at moderate strength.
source_ref: schema/spec.md EV.claim_basis; review-card buckets in scripts/build-row-review-batch.py

label: Expert assertion
definition: An assertion without a stated measurement (claim_basis expert_assertion or another unmeasured basis); weighted down in synthesis.
source_ref: schema/spec.md EV.claim_basis; review-card buckets in scripts/build-row-review-batch.py
